title: Managing George Lewis: Bakersfield concert, bootleg tape, first bookings
summary: Tait discusses dating the 1954 Bakersfield recording, then how she came to hear the band in Hollywood, arranged the concert, fought a bootleg tape, took over managing, booked dates, Lawrence's collapse, and the college tour with Johnny Lucas.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
